info.name: OCI Cache Oci Cache User API
Gets a list of all OCI cache users based on the supplied parameters.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The ID of the compartment in which to list resources.

params.name: name
params.description: A filter to return the resources that match with the given OCI cache user name.

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description: A filter to return the resources, whose lifecycleState matches with the given lifecycleState.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description: A token representing the position at which to start retrieving results. This must come from the `opc-next-page` header field of a previous response.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'ASC' or 'DESC'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. Default order for timeCreated is descending. Default order for displayName is ascending.

items.docs: Lists the OCI Cache users based on the supplied parameters.

info.name: Creates a new OCI Cache User.

items.docs: Creates a new OCI Cache user. OCI Cache user is required to authenticate to OCI Cache cluster.

info.name: Get an existing OCI Cache User for the given ID (OCID).

params.name: ociCacheUserId
params.description: A filter to return only resources, that match with the given OCI cache user ID (OCID).

items.docs: Get an existing OCI Cache users based on the ID (OCID).

info.name: Update an existing OCI Cache User with supplied parameters.

params.name: ociCacheUserId
params.description: A filter to return only resources, that match with the given OCI cache user ID (OCID).

items.docs: Update an existing OCI Cache User with new details.

info.name: Delete an existing OCI cache user based on the ID.

params.name: ociCacheUserId
params.description: A filter to return only resources, that match with the given OCI cache user ID (OCID).

items.docs: Deletes an existing OCI Cache User based on the OCI cache user unique ID (OCID).

info.name: Moves an OCI cache user from one compartment to another compartment.

params.name: ociCacheUserId
params.description: A filter to return only resources, that match with the given OCI cache user ID (OCID).

items.docs: Moves an OCI Cache User from one compartment to another within the same tenancy.
